integrity: The result is derived from the stated definitions and spectral theory; the existing characterization of the essential-norm identity is cited rather than presented as original. Literature searches cannot guarantee publication priority.
scientific_limitations: Positive norm-one contractions only; infinite-dimensional separable complex Hilbert domains; index normalized by the near-norm-attainment seminorm, not the full operator norm. General operators, real scalars, Banach spaces, and independent validation are outside the claim.
title: A zero-or-half relative numerical-index dichotomy for positive Hilbert contractions
